name: Dispatch Self-Hosted Newsletter Service
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted newsletter and transactional email software; no provider-imposed message quota or software expiry. Supports subscriber lists, scheduled sends, REST API, CLI and MCP.
watch_out: Requires your own server, storage and SMTP/SES/Mailgun or other relay; delivery costs, provider quotas, DNS setup, abuse controls and infrastructure are not included. Software is not free hosted email sending.
